criteria.description: All committed and assistant-authored visible tests pass.
Private concurrency, recovery, version, terminal-state, isolation, and evidence checks pass.
Per-trade serialization, cross-trade concurrency, commit-after-persist, and rejection recovery are correct.
Event validation, exact version progression, stale handling, terminal cancellation, and mutation isolation are correct.
Only allowed files change, at least four meaningful tests are added, and the incident report is complete and accurate.
